judge_notes: No behavioural assays were conducted in this study. The in vivo mouse experiment involved systemic DOI/lisuride injection followed by transcardiac perfusion and immunohistochemistry to detect phospho-Ser280 5-HT2A receptor staining — this is a histological/biochemical endpoint, not a behavioural assay, and is excluded per scoring rubric.

All other experiments are in vitro (HEK-293 cells, primary cortical neuron cultures) measuring inositol phosphate production, Erk1,2 phosphorylation, receptor internalization, beta-arrestin recruitment, and mass spectrometry — none are behavioural assays.
All three candidates agreed that no scorable behavioural assays exist (empty assays list).
